digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and git checkout optimization
propositions: CI workflows must apply --filter=blob:none to all tickets-branch fetch operations to reduce transfer size and time from full 1+ GiB multi-minute fetches to sub-100 MiB sub-minute fetches
Named-remote partial clone filters must be verified to inherit through plain git fetch origin commands via protocol negotiation capability advertisement and packet trace validation
Direct-URL git fetches in Gerrit workflows require explicit --filter=blob:none flags to match named-remote semantics while preserving existing depth and credential handling
Production guards must parse git count-objects pack size and fail workflows when unfiltered fetches exceed declared thresholds (102400 KiB standalone, 131072 KiB Gerrit post-materialization)

Real-Git protocol tests must confirm filter capability advertisement, blob:none request transmission, and missing-object behavior across named-remote and direct-URL fetch paths using packet trace validation
Post-materialization git count-objects snapshots must remain unchanged to prove worktree/checkout adds no new promisor objects beyond server-provided filtered clone state
